gloss: hard to sleep; restless (due to heat)

definitions.gloss: hard to sleep; unable to sleep comfortably; restless
definitions.explanation: Describes a state where one cannot sleep well, typically because of heat, humidity, or uncomfortable conditions. Most often associated with hot summer nights.

examples.japanese: {寝苦|ねぐる}しい{夜|よる}が{続|つづ}く。
{暑|あつ}くて{寝苦|ねぐる}しいので、エアコンをつけた。
examples.english: It was so hot I couldn't sleep, so I turned on the air conditioner.

examples.japanese: {梅雨|つゆ}の{時期|じき}は{湿度|しつど}が{高|たか}くて{寝苦|ねぐる}しい{日|ひ}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: During the rainy season, there are many nights where it's too humid to sleep well.

notes: Almost exclusively used to describe difficulty sleeping due to heat or humidity, especially during Japanese summers. The most common collocation is {寝苦|ねぐる}しい{夜|よる} (a restless/sleepless night), frequently heard in weather forecasts: {今夜|こんや}も{寝苦|ねぐる}しい{夜|よる}になるでしょう (Tonight will be another uncomfortable night for sleeping). Part of the ～{苦|ぐる}しい pattern meaning 'hard to do ~,' like {見苦|みぐる}しい (unsightly), {聞|きき}き{苦|ぐる}しい (unpleasant to hear).
